from transformers import AutoTokenizer

def test_tokenizer(model_path, expected_format, label):

    print(f"Testing: {label} ({model_path})")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    
    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
    
    # Test get_turn_markers

    print(f"Format: {markers['format']}")
    assert markers['format'] == expected_format, f"Expected {expected_format}, got {markers['format']}"
    print(f"Start: {markers['start']}, End: {markers['end']}")
    
    # Test _get_special_token_ids
    info = _get_special_token_ids(tok)
    print(f"Start ID: {info['start_id']}, End ID: {info['end_id']}")
    if expected_format == 'llama3':
        print(f"End Header ID: {info['end_header_id']}")
    
    # Build a multi-turn conversation
    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
        {"role": "user", "content": "What is machine learning?"},
        {"role": "assistant", "content": "Machine learning is a subset of AI that enables systems to learn from data."},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Can you give an example?"},
        {"role": "assistant", "content": "Sure, spam filtering is a classic example of machine learning."},
    ]
    
    text = tok.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False)
    encoding = tok(text, return_tensors="pt")
    input_ids = encoding.input_ids.squeeze(0)
    print(f"Sequence length: {len(input_ids)}")
    
    # Test detect_turn_boundaries (ours)
    result = detect_turn_boundaries(input_ids, tok, gar_variant="ours")
    turns = result['turns']
    print(f"Turns detected: {len(turns)}")
    roles = [t['role'] for t in turns]
    print(f"Roles: {roles}")
    assert len(turns) == 5, f"Expected 5 turns, got {len(turns)}"
    assert roles == ['system', 'user', 'assistant', 'user', 'assistant'], f"Wrong roles: {roles}"
    
    # Check content makes sense
    for t in turns:
        content_tokens = input_ids[t['content_start']:t['content_end']]
        content_text = tok.decode(content_tokens)
        print(f"  {t['role']}: content_start={t['content_start']} content_end={t['content_end']} len={t['content_end']-t['content_start']} preview='{content_text[:50]}...'")
        assert t['content_start'] <= t['content_end'], f"content_start > content_end for {t['role']}"
        assert t['content_end'] - t['content_start'] > 0, f"Empty content for {t['role']}"
    
    # Check goal positions
    goal_pos = result['goal_token_positions']
    print(f"Goal token positions (ours): {len(goal_pos)} tokens")
    assert len(goal_pos) > 0, "No goal tokens found"
    
    # Check assistant positions
    asst_pos = result['assistant_last_token_positions']
    print(f"Assistant last token positions: {asst_pos}")
    assert len(asst_pos) == 2, f"Expected 2 assistant positions, got {len(asst_pos)}"
    
    # Test detect_turn_boundaries (dongre)

    goal_pos_d = result_d['goal_token_positions']
    print(f"Goal token positions (dongre): {len(goal_pos_d)} tokens")
    assert len(goal_pos_d) > 0, "No dongre goal tokens"
    assert len(goal_pos_d) <= len(goal_pos), "Dongre should have fewer goal tokens than ours"
    
    # Test build_turn_features
    feats = build_turn_features(input_ids, tok)
    print(f"Turn features keys: {list(feats.keys())}")
    assert feats['turn_distance'].shape[0] == len(input_ids)
    assert feats['turn_index'].shape[0] == len(input_ids)
    assert feats['is_turn_boundary'].shape[0] == len(input_ids)
    assert feats['turn_index'].max().item() == 4, f"Expected max turn index 4, got {feats['turn_index'].max().item()}"
    
    # Check boundaries are at special tokens
    boundary_count = feats['is_turn_boundary'].sum().item()
    print(f"Boundary positions: {boundary_count}")
    assert boundary_count >= 10, f"Expected at least 10 boundary positions, got {boundary_count}"
    
    print(f"\n✅ All tests passed for {label}!")
